title: Ten Bugs and Ten Bins
lines: Ben and Meg dug up ten bugs.
"Bugs can nap in the bins," said Ben.
But bugs dig. The bugs dug and dug.
Ten bugs got up and got in the mud.
"See? Bugs do not nap in bins," said Meg.
Ben and Meg dug a pit in the mud.
The bugs dig in it. It is a den.

questions.ask: Where did Ben put the ten bugs at first?
questions.listenFor: In the bins. Line two says it. If your child is unsure, point to the word bins and read that line again.

questions.ask: What did the bugs do in the bins?
questions.listenFor: They dug, and they got out. Lines three and four say it. Listen for them noticing that bugs dig - that is why the bins never worked.

questions.ask: The last line calls the pit a den. What is a den?
questions.listenFor: A home an animal digs or hides in. Line seven. If they are stuck, ask where a fox sleeps.
